### Changes

- Add HDR PNG output to Photo Frame on Windows and Android, with PQ and HLG options. Expand camera and phone logo coverage and improve model captions.
- Improve handling of very large AVIF images, including memory-aware decoding on the Web.
- Preserve custom filename suffixes when switching output formats or transfer functions. Keep the Photo Frame output format when editing unrelated Windows tasks.
- Adjust Windows quality sliders in five-point steps when clicking the track.
- Support Windows PowerShell 5.1 for local Web builds.
